headline: OpenAI Raises $11 Billion, Falling Short of $30 Billion Target
summary: OpenAI raised $11 billion toward a $30 billion target as investor appetite for artificial intelligence cools, according to the Wall Street Journal.
why: OpenAI is the developer of ChatGPT and a bellwether for venture capital and institutional funding across the generative AI sector.

impacts.name: OpenAI
impacts.why: OpenAI secured $11 billion in new capital, falling short of its initial $30 billion funding target.
